The '''Shiritoku Spur''' was an underpopulated<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> area of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that included such [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] as [[B'Knos]], [[G'rho]], [[Cattamascar]], [[Gymelo]], [[Kammia]], and the [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]]. Also running through the region was the [[Shiritoku Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which began at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] world of [[Timora]]. 

Most of its worlds chose never to join the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and politically belonged to the Wild Space.<ref name="TEA" /> The Spur was invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
